name: Jindal Worldwide Ltd
about: Jindal Worldwide Ltd is engaged in the Textiles Sector and the main business activities are related to the manufacturing of Denim fabric, premium shirtings, yarn dyeing, bottom weights and home textiles through its various internal divisions [1]
keyPoints:
Leading Denim Manufacturer
Founded in 1986 by Dr Yamunadutt Agrawal, Jindal Worldwide Ltd is a diversified and integrated textile fabric and shirting manufacturer and is Asia’s largest fully integrated manufacturer of denim fabric. JWL is the flagship company of the Ahmedabad-based Jindal Group. [1]

pros: Promoter holding has increased by 1.35% over last quarter.
cons: Stock is trading at 3.92 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.80% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.2% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 2.92% of profits over last 3 years
